    // True when the query, in the box's own frame, is within the half-extents on
    // all three axes. Boundary inclusive.
    Contains(b: Box3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var q = LocalOffset(b.Center, b.Orientation, point);
        return q.X.Abs <= b.Size.Width * 0.5
            && q.Y.Abs <= b.Size.Height * 0.5
            && q.Z.Abs <= b.Size.Depth * 0.5;
    }
```

## Line 228

    // The standard rounded-box inside test: fold the query into the first octant of
    // the box's own frame, subtract the core half-extents, and compare the
    // resulting distance to the corner radius. Boundary inclusive.
    // https://iquilezles.org/articles/distfunctions/
    Contains(b: RoundedBox3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var r = b.EffectiveCornerRadius;
        var e = b.CoreExtents;
        var local = LocalOffset(b.Box.Center, b.Box.Orientation, point);
        var qx = local.X.Abs - e.X * 0.5;
        var qy = local.Y.Abs - e.Y * 0.5;
        var qz = local.Z.Abs - e.Z * 0.5;
        var outside = (qx.Max(0.0).Square + qy.Max(0.0).Square + qz.Max(0.0).Square).Sqrt;
        return outside + qx.Max(qy).Max(qz).Min(0.0) <= r;
    }
```

    // True when the query is within half the height along the axis AND within the
    // radius of the axis. Boundary inclusive on both.
    Contains(c: Cylinder, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var v = c.Center.Between(point);
        return v.Dot(c.Axis.Vector).Abs <= c.Height * 0.5
            && PerpendicularComponent(v, c.Axis.Vector).MagnitudeSquared <= c.Radius.Square;
    }
```

    // True when the query is within half the height along the axis AND its distance
    // from the axis lies in [InnerRadius, OuterRadius].
    Contains(s: CylindricalShell, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var v = s.Center.Between(point);
        var radialSquared = PerpendicularComponent(v, s.Axis.Vector).MagnitudeSquared;
        return v.Dot(s.Axis.Vector).Abs <= s.Height * 0.5
            && radialSquared >= s.InnerRadius.Square
            && radialSquared <= s.OuterRadius.Square;
    }
```

```plato

    // True when the query lies between the Apex and the base plane AND within the
    // cone's radius at that height, which grows linearly as r*t/h. Boundary
    // inclusive.
    Contains(c: Cone, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var v = c.Apex.Between(point);
        var t = v.Dot(c.Axis.Vector);
        return t >= 0.0 && t <= c.Height
            && PerpendicularComponent(v, c.Axis.Vector).Magnitude <= c.Radius * t / c.Height;
    }
```

## Line 511

```plato

    // True when the query lies between the two disks AND within the frustum's
    // radius at that height, which interpolates linearly from r1 to r2.
    Contains(f: ConicalFrustum, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var v = f.Center.Between(point);
        var t = v.Dot(f.Axis.Vector);
        var fraction = (t + f.Height * 0.5) / f.Height;
        return t.Abs <= f.Height * 0.5
            && PerpendicularComponent(v, f.Axis.Vector).Magnitude
                <= f.BottomRadius + (f.TopRadius - f.BottomRadius) * fraction;
    }
```

## Line 716

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato, line 716](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato#L716).

```plato

    // True when the four sub-tetrahedra formed by replacing one vertex with the
    // query all have the SAME orientation as the whole — equivalently, when all
    // four barycentric coordinates are non-negative. A zero term means the query is
    // on that face, so the boundary is included.
    Contains(t: Tetrahedron, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var whole = SixTimesSignedVolume(t.A, t.B, t.C, t.D);
        return SixTimesSignedVolume(point, t.B, t.C, t.D) * whole >= 0.0
            && SixTimesSignedVolume(t.A, point, t.C, t.D) * whole >= 0.0
            && SixTimesSignedVolume(t.A, t.B, point, t.D) * whole >= 0.0
            && SixTimesSignedVolume(t.A, t.B, t.C, point) * whole >= 0.0;
    }
```

## Line 760

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato, line 760](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato#L760).

```plato

    // True when the query solves (point - A) = u*AB + v*AC + s*Offset with u, v
    // and u+v in [0, 1] (inside the base triangle) and s in [0, 1] (inside the
    // sweep). Solved by Cramer's rule on the 3x3 frame; each determinant is a
    // scalar triple product. Boundary inclusive. Undefined (division by zero) when
    // Offset lies in the base plane. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cramer%27s_rule
    Contains(w: Wedge, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var ab = w.Base.A.Between(w.Base.B);
        var ac = w.Base.A.Between(w.Base.C);
        var ap = w.Base.A.Between(point);
        var determinant = ab.Cross(ac).Dot(w.Offset);
        var u = ap.Cross(ac).Dot(w.Offset) / determinant;
        var v = ab.Cross(ap).Dot(w.Offset) / determinant;
        var s = ab.Cross(ac).Dot(ap) / determinant;
        return u >= 0.0 && v >= 0.0 && u + v <= 1.0 && s >= 0.0 && s <= 1.0;
    }
```

## Line 777

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato, line 777](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato#L777).

```plato

    //==
    // # ConvexVolume

    // True when the query is behind EVERY bounding plane (the normals point
    // outward), which is exactly the intersection of the half-spaces. Boundary
    // inclusive. An empty plane list reports true — the intersection of no
    // half-spaces is all of space.
    Contains(v: ConvexVolume, point: Point3D): Boolean
        => v.Planes.All(p => p.SignedDistance(point) <= 0.0);
```

    // True when the distance from the centre lies in [InnerRadius, OuterRadius];
    // both boundaries inclusive.
    Contains(s: SphericalShell, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var distanceSquared = s.Center.Between(point).MagnitudeSquared;
        return distanceSquared >= s.InnerRadius.Square
            && distanceSquared <= s.OuterRadius.Square;

    // True when the point lies in the ball AND within PolarAngle of the axis as
    // seen from the sphere's centre — the latter written as a plane test,
    // (p - C).axis >= R cos theta, which is exactly the cutting plane.
    Contains(c: SphericalCap, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var v = c.Sphere.Center.Between(point);
        return v.MagnitudeSquared <= c.Sphere.Radius.Square
            && v.Dot(c.Axis.Vector) >= c.Sphere.Radius * c.PolarAngle.Cos;
    }
```

    // True when (x/a)^2 + (y/b)^2 + (z/c)^2 <= 1 in the ellipsoid's own frame.
    Contains(e: Ellipsoid, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var q = LocalOffset(e.Center, e.Orientation, point);
        return (q.X / e.SemiAxes.X).Square
            + (q.Y / e.SemiAxes.Y).Square
            + (q.Z / e.SemiAxes.Z).Square <= 1.0;
    }
```

```plato

    // True when the query is within MinorRadius of the major circle: writing the
    // query in axial (t) and radial (d) cylindrical coordinates about the centre,
    // (d - R)^2 + t^2 <= r^2. Boundary inclusive.
    Contains(t: Torus, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var v = t.Center.Between(point);
        var axial = v.Dot(t.Axis.Vector);
        var radial = PerpendicularComponent(v, t.Axis.Vector).Magnitude;
        return (radial - t.MajorRadius).Square + axial.Square <= t.MinorRadius.Square;
    }
}
```
